1.why: auth() validates the session cookie and requires s.userId === account.id before any MFA endpoint proceeds.

2.why: There is no multi-user support and the pending TOTP secret is tied to the single authenticated account, so a code is not usable by another user.

3.why: /api/mfa/verify enables MFA without deleting existing entries in sessions, so previously issued session tokens remain valid until timeout or logout.

4.why: Pending and enabled OTP secrets are stored as AES-GCM ciphertext and recovery codes are stored as SHA-256 hashes plus encrypted ciphertext.

5.why: base32, token, and recoveryCode all use crypto.getRandomValues.

6.why: The session identifier is set only in an HttpOnly cookie and the code does not use localStorage, sessionStorage, or non-HttpOnly cookies for secrets, OTPs, or tokens.

7.why: Login validates email and phone with strict patterns, OTP and recovery-code inputs are checked against strict server-side patterns, and request body size and content type are constrained.

8.why: Dynamic values inserted into the page are passed through esc(), which assigns textContent before reading innerHTML, and CSP nonces restrict script execution.

9.why: The server sends no Location redirects and client-side navigation only uses fixed internal hash routes.

10.why: headers() sets CSP with frame-ancestors 'none', HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, and X-Frame-Options DENY.

11.why: Set-Cookie for bank_session includes HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite=Strict.

12.why: Client-side logging writes the OTP secret, test OTP, and recovery codes into the logs/DOM, although error output is generic and stack traces are not exposed.

13.why: The pending OTP expires after five minutes and p.used is set true after one successful verification.

14.why: After five failed OTP attempts, p.locked blocks further verification for ten minutes, and recovery redemption has a similar lockout.

15.why: Login deletes an existing presented session and creates a new token, auth enforces idle and absolute timeouts, and logout deletes the session.
